price_note.en: Daily starting price*. The daily price includes tax, insurance and unlimited mileage unless a promotional price says otherwise. Final price depends on rental period and season — ask us for a quote.
price_note.sr: Početna dnevna cena*. Dnevna cena uključuje porez, osiguranje i neograničenu kilometražu, osim ako promotivna cena ne kaže drugačije. Konačna cena zavisi od dužine najma i sezone — zatražite ponudu.

text.en: Enhance your travel with seamless airport pick-up and drop-off at Belgrade Airport.
text.sr: Ulepšajte svoje putovanje prevozom sa i do beogradskog aerodroma.

text.en: Enhance your rental with extras like baby seats, Wi-Fi, snow chains, or a Thule roof box.

text.en: Enhance your convenience with multiple locations in Belgrade for pick-up and drop-off.
text.sr: Uživajte u većoj fleksibilnosti uz više lokacija u Beogradu za preuzimanje i vraćanje vozila.

text.en: Enhance your journey by taking your rental car abroad for a small additional fee.
text.sr: Naša vozila možete koristiti i za putovanja u inostranstvo uz dodatnu naknadu.
